The Raipur-Visakhapatnam Expressway is a major infrastructure project that is set to revolutionize connectivity between the central and eastern regions of India. This ambitious project will significantly reduce travel time and boost economic growth in the corridor it traverses.
Key Features of the Expressway:
Length: Approximately 464 kilometers
Lane Configuration: Six-lane, divided highway
Route: The expressway will pass through the states of Chhattisgarh, Odisha, and Andhra Pradesh.
